text: Nate went to a game convention last Friday, met new people outside his circle, and made friends who love games; they planned a gaming session. He played Catan and loves it, though it can be competitive or chill. Games and movies are his escape; he's not very competitive. He saw Inception and is playing Cyberpunk 2077. Joanna suggested a multi-person fluffy couch, weighted blanket, and dimmable lights for comfort.
